name: Magic Hour Rooftop Bar & Lounge
address: Moxy NYC Times Square, 485 7th Ave, 18th floor, New York, NY 10018 (street entrance on 7th Ave between 36th and 37th St)
status_note: Official Moxy page is current: 'Dark Magic Hour' Halloween takeover runs through Oct 31, 2026. Operated by Tao Group; a reviewer notes it is run separately from the hotel (no room charges, no direct access from hotel elevators).

dress.detail: The official FAQ says 'fun, casual, no true athletic wear'; The Rooftop Guide also lists no shorts or sandals after 9pm.

age.value: 21+ except weekend brunch (Sat-Sun 11:30am-3pm, all ages); physical government ID, non-US ID needs a passport

cover.value: None listed; no minimum or fee to reserve ($30 no-show fee on the card)

getting_in.value: Walk-ins welcome at the bar; tables first-come via the door team. Reserve on OpenTable (card required, 90-minute table block, 15-minute grace period).

hours.value: Mon-Wed 5pm-12am; Thu 5pm-2am; Fri 5pm-4am; Sat 11:30am-4am; Sun 11:30am-12am (brunch Sat-Sun 11:30am-3:30pm)

price.value: Happy hour Mon-Fri 5-6:30pm at the bar: $6 Estrella, $8 house wine, $10 spritzes. Regular cocktails reported as typical-to-high Manhattan rooftop prices (no menu prices found).

skip_if: You want an interactive theme: a 2025 review found the mini-golf gone and the theming underwhelming, with pricey drinks.
You want attentive service at peak times: reviewers report slow or inattentive service when it is busy.
